AL.modal_quote: The Board does not permit the use of corporal punishment as a consequence for inappropriate behavior provided that school personnel are not prohibited from using appropriate physical contact or intervention in response to emergencies or other circumstances reasonably requiring such action.

AR.modal_quote: 25 CORPORAL PUNISHMENT Using physical force to discipline students is not permitted.

AZ.modal_quote: The District does not permit the use of corporal punishment.

CO.modal_quote: Corporal Punishment (District Policy 5140) District Policy 5140 prohibits the use of corporal punishment by any staff member.

FL.modal_quote: The use of corporal punishment is prohibited.

GA.modal_quote: APS prohibits the use of corporal punishment by all employees.

ID.modal_quote: No person who is employed or engaged by the District may inflict or cause to be inflicted corporal punishment on a student.

IN.modal_quote: Corporal punishment shall not be used by the Board's employees.

KS.modal_quote: Corporal punishment shall not be permitted in the school district.

KY.modal_quote: Employees shall not utilize corporal punishment as a penalty or punishment for student misbehavior.

LA.modal_quote: IMPERMISSIBLE CORPORAL PUNISHMENT OR MORAL OFFENSES If a student, parent or other person files a complaint in writing with the Caddo Parish School Board accusing a school employee of impermissible corporal punishment or moral offenses involving students, the complaint will be investigated as follows:

MI.modal_quote: Prohibition Employees will not inflict, or cause to be inflicted, corporal punishment upon any student under any circumstances.

MO.modal_quote: Corporal punishment is strictly prohibited as a method of discipline.

MS.modal_quote: Corporal punishment is not a disciplinary practice used within the Biloxi Public School District. Parent may not request that corporal punishment be used in lieu of other disciplinary actions.

NC.modal_quote: No school plan for managing student behavior may authorize the use of corporal punishment.

NH.modal_quote: Permission to administer corporal punishment will not be sought or accepted from any parent, guardian, or school official.

OH.modal_quote: Corporal punishment is prohibited and shall not be used as a form of discipline in the District.

OK.modal_quote: Corporal punishment will not be utilized at any school site.

SC.modal_quote: Policy CORPORAL PUNISHMENT/PHYSICAL FORCE (NEW) Code JKA Issued DRAFT/18 The use of corporal punishment, defined as any act of physical force upon a student for the purpose of punishing that student, is not acceptable in this district and will not be tolerated as a disciplinary measure.

TN.modal_quote: Corporal punishment shall not be used as a disciplinary measure in any school.

TX.modal_quote: Corporal Punishment The Board prohibits the use of corporal punishment in the District.

WI.modal_quote: Expulsion Suspension Detention, including Saturday school Clean-up duty Loss of student privileges Loss of bus privileges Notification to juvenile authorities and/or police Restitution for damages to school property No District employee or person engaged by the District may inflict or cause to be inflicted corporal punishment on a student.

WY.modal_quote: Corporal punishment (spanking) shall not be administered to a student.
